name: GDPR Compliance for AI Systems MCP Server
description: Provides comprehensive GDPR compliance assessment tools for AI/ML systems, including lawful basis determination, DPIA generation, and data subject rights handling. It also crosswalks GDPR requirements to EU AI Act obligations with AI-specific considerations throughout.
